about:
L3Harris Power Paragon is based in Anaheim, California, and operates as part of L3Harris Technologies, a major aerospace and defense contractor. The unit specializes in engineered power distribution solutions, though its specific founding year and ownership details are not disclosed in public records.

The company designs and manufactures custom switchgear spanning low-, medium-, and high-voltage ratings, as well as DC power systems and automated transfer switchgear. Its offerings include power distribution control centers, automatic transfer switchgear for paralleling applications, and DC switchgear and bus systems. Power Paragon’s customer base spans commercial construction, utility and power generation, government and military agencies, and data center operators. These industries depend on the company’s tailored switchgear for reliable power distribution and control in mission-critical environments.

name: LA Packaging

about:
LA Packaging was founded in 1984 by Edward Loritz Sr. in Yorba Linda, California. The company began with a commitment to supply American-made hinged-lid plastic containers at affordable prices, a mission that continues under family leadership today.

The company manufactures clarified polypropylene, polyethylene, and ESD plastic containers and vials, primarily using injection molding. Its product lines include hinged-lid containers, ESD-inhibiting containers, and custom options such as hot stamping and labeling. Production capabilities have expanded to serve customers across North America, Europe, and Asia, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

LA Packaging serves the electronics, medical, pharmaceutical, food, laboratory, and industrial sectors. Its containers are designed for applications requiring medical-grade Class VI polypropylene that is REACH, RoHS, and FDA compliant. The company also operates two e-commerce sites: lacontainerstore.com for bulk orders (domestic only) and esdplasticcontainers.com for small-quantity purchases with no minimum order.

The founder’s original emphasis on high-quality, U.S.-made materials that do not leach or degrade remains a stated differentiator. LA Packaging highlights its use of medical-grade polypropylene, compliance with REACH and RoHS, and a customer-service approach that includes Net 30 terms and direct phone support.

name: LC Fine Foods
old_description: LC Cash and Carry, also known as LC Fine Food, is an establishment steeped in history, founded by the late and great Italo “Leo” Ciocca in the year 1965. Leo’s vision was to offer the finest Italian imports to his esteemed clientele. With his unwavering commitment to excellence and his unbridled passion for the food industry, Leo expanded his business, reaching new heights of success, while simultaneously adding new products and acquiring new customers across the wholesale and retail sectors. Today, his legacy lives on through LC Cash and Carry, where the tradition of offering authentic Italian products still remains strong, while at the same time, embracing the evolution of the market by adding a vast assortment of domestic products to cater to a wider audience.
about:
LC Fine Foods, operating as LC Cash and Carry, has been a fixture in New Haven, Connecticut since 1965. The company was founded by Italian immigrant Italo "Leo" Ciocca, who envisioned bringing the finest Italian imports to his community. What began as a modest enterprise grew into a family-owned wholesale and retail food business that continues under the leadership of Ciocca's children, Carlo and Danny.

The company distributes a broad assortment of Italian and domestic food products across categories that include produce, deli meats, cheeses, pasta, olive oils, bakery goods, coffee, and seasonal specialties. From a remodeled storefront in New Haven, LC Fine Foods serves both wholesale accounts and walk-in retail customers, offering delivery service throughout the region.

Its customer base spans restaurants, delicatessens, institutional kitchens, and individual consumers. A deli operator in New Haven County cites the company as a primary supplier for fresh produce and cold cuts, while retail shoppers seek out traditional items such as panettone and pandoro during the holidays.

Ciocca's original commitment to quality and personal service remains the stated differentiator. The company emphasizes long-standing supplier relationships, both domestic and international, and a practice of sourcing from local farmers and dairy producers whenever possible to support the surrounding community.

name: LGC Clinical Diagnostics (Maine Standards)
old_description: Maine Standards is a market leader for linearity and calibration verification products. Our modern laboratory and streamlined processes allow us to consistently manufacture products that are of the highest quality, are easy-to-use and are incredibly efficient.
about:
LGC Maine Standards operates from Cumberland Foreside, Maine. The business originated as Maine Standards Company, LLC, a specialist in linearity and calibration verification with more than a century of experience in that niche. In November 2015, the company was acquired by LGC, a global life sciences measurement and testing firm founded in 1842 and now owned by funds affiliated with KKR. The acquisition brought Maine Standards into LGC’s portfolio of reference materials, proficiency testing, and genomics reagents.

At its Maine facility, the company manufactures liquid, ready-to-use, multi-level calibration verification sets under the VALIDATE® brand, designed for the most widely used clinical laboratory instruments. The modern laboratory and streamlined processes support production of these quality-control products, which are shipped on customer schedules. While specific facility size and headcount for the Maine site are not disclosed, LGC employs over 2,000 people across 22 countries.

The products serve clinical laboratories and healthcare professionals across diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, agricultural biotechnology, food safety, environmental testing, government agencies, and academic research. LGC’s broader measurement services also underpin safety and regulatory compliance in these sectors.

The company states its purpose is to improve the quality of human diagnostics, backing its offerings with a 100% customer satisfaction guarantee, expert technical support, and a global logistics network. Compliance with the AdvaMed Code of Ethics and accreditation to standards such as ISO 13485:2016, ISO/IEC 17025, and ISO Guide 34 further distinguish its operations.

name: LGND ENERGY
old_description: Your home is one of the biggest investments you will ever make. Utilizing solar energy will help improve the value of a home while giving you benefits while living in the home. Solar panels from LGND Energy are of the highest quality on the market in New Mexico. We have been working to provide roofing and solar solutions for homeowners for many years. Using solar energy gives you the freedom to control your power production, lower your energy bill, and help improve the environment.
about:
LGND Energy operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where brothers Elmer and Octavio Reyna founded the company in 2019. After years sales teams at larger solar firms, the Reyna brothers launched their own dealership to bring a family-oriented approach to both their representatives and customers across the Southwest.

The company designs and installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems, integrates battery storage using Tesla Powerwall 3 and Enphase units, and provides roofing consultations that assess structural readiness for solar arrays. Crews also fit critter guards, clean panels, and handle permitting and HOA coordination for projects throughout Bernalillo County and the wider Albuquerque metro area.

Homeowners, small and large businesses, and multi-family property owners make up the client base. Recent work includes pigeon-barrier installations on residential arrays, commercial rooftop systems aimed at lowering operating costs, and backup-battery retrofits that keep power flowing during grid outages.

The founders frame the business around passing installation savings directly to homeowners and rewarding sales staff without high-pressure tactics. Extensive rep training and a hands-on, family-run culture are cited as the reasons customers return for maintenance and refer neighbors.

name: LIW Furniture
old_description: We are a family owned custom furniture company based in the heart of Lancaster County, Pa. Our experienced team specializes in modern, contemporary iron and hardwood furniture including tables, cabinets, office furniture and more. We love bringing your big ideas to life, whether you need tables and chairs for your business or restaurant, or you want to invest in a specialized dining set for your home.
about:
LIW Furniture operates as Lancaster Iron & Wood, a family-owned custom furniture and cabinetry company rooted in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. The business is owned by Case Taylor, who brought hands-on experience from Amish Artisan Woodcraft in cabinetry, millwork, and custom furniture to the operation. The company describes its shop as a Lancaster, PA wood shop where all pieces are hand crafted, though its website also lists a Navarre, Ohio address.

The company produces custom hardwood and iron furniture including dining tables, chairs, cabinets, built-ins, vanities, bars, and office furniture. Its team works with locally sourced hardwoods from native Appalachian forests, many from Pennsylvania, and offers live-edge tops, custom base options, a range of stains and paints, and proprietary hardware and metal features. Customers can select from a catalogue of solid-wood designs or collaborate with designers and craftsmen on fully custom pieces for residential or commercial projects.

LIW serves homeowners, restaurants, retail spaces, offices, and other commercial clients. A restaurant owner, John Harris, noted the company produced dining tables for his establishment, while residential customers Sarah Benhayon and Jacqueline Swazy referenced custom dining sets and live-edge tables. The firm emphasizes its ability to handle projects small and large, from a single dining set to a full restaurant fit-out.

Taylor states the goal is to continue building on the craftsmanship LIW has long been known for while expanding custom possibilities. The company highlights its control over materials through local partnerships, a quality standard that every piece must be acceptable in their own homes, and a professional team of designers, project managers, and craftsmen who bring pride and passion to each project.

about:
LQ Mechatronics operates from Branford, Connecticut, as the U.S. arm of the LQ Group, a German system supplier specializing in electromechanical complete solutions for machine and plant engineering. The founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures modular control cabinets, energy guide systems, and custom cable assemblies, all built around its EnergyLink system kit—a standardized set of connectors, power cables, distributors, and functional modules that eliminate interface issues. It also assembles drag chains (energy chains) and provides end-to-end services from engineering through logistics. The group reports 365 specialists across three locations, producing 305,000 systems and 2,990 kilometers of cable annually.

LQ Mechatronics serves machine builders, plant constructors, and the packaging industry, evidenced by its membership in the Packaging Valley network since 2016. Its solutions are used in automation environments requiring robust, pre-assembled energy chains and compact functional modules such as the A-TEC series.

The company emphasizes complexity reduction through standardized interfaces, claiming accelerated processes and 100% tested quality on every custom assembly. Its differentiation rests on delivering pre-assembled, ready-to-install energy chains and a holistic approach covering engineering to after-sales service.

name: Laguna Fabrics
old_description: Since 2000, Laguna has been making fabric with raw materials that have a lower environmental impact than conventional materials and today we are doing even more.
about:
Laguna Fabrics was founded in 1986 in Los Angeles, California, by Monet Goode and has been operated by the Roshan family across multiple generations. The company began as a circular knitting mill serving the contemporary fashion market and has remained a family-owned business for nearly 35 years.

The mill runs in-house circular knitting machines from low to fine gauge, with a capacity of 1.5 million pounds per month, and offers special finishes such as brushing and sueding along with fabric laundering. With 40 employees, Laguna produces over 10 million yards annually, focusing on certified sustainable fibers including GOTS organic cotton, TENCEL™ lyocell, TENCEL™ modal, recycled cotton, and hemp. Services include technical fabric analysis, new construction engineering, on-trend fabric development, on-demand sample yardage, and a showroom with a complete lab-dip catalog.

Laguna supplies trend-forward knits to contemporary fashion brands, independent designers, and start-up labels, emphasizing quick turnaround enabled by domestic production. Longtime clients receive dedicated service, while the company also supports younger designers and smaller ventures with low minimums and development assistance.

The company’s differentiation rests on its GOTS certification—it claims to be the only circular knit mill in the United States with that credential—and a commitment to provenance, process transparency, and product authenticity. Since 2000 it has shifted toward lower-impact materials, joining the Textile Exchange and the California Cotton & Climate Coalition, with a stated goal of reaching 90 percent sustainable material output by 2025.

name: Lakeland Engineering Equipment Company - Kansas City
old_description: Delta Fabricating designs and manufactures a variety of enclosures to protect your sophisticated electrical and electronic controls, instruments, and components from water, dust, dirt, oil and other environmental conditions. Delta Fabricating specializes in custom enclosures and panels to fit the needs of many industrial and commercial applications while providing quick delivery times.
about:
Lakeland Engineering Equipment Company, headquartered in Kansas City, Kansas, traces its roots to 1952 when Bill Fox founded the business in Minneapolis as a family-owned distributor of process motor controls and electrical components. Over seven decades, the company has grown from a Midwestern supplier into an international enterprise with locations across four states.

The company operates as a broad-line distributor for more than 100 electrical component manufacturers, stocking items such as motor controls, solenoid valves, drives, switches, PLCs, HMIs, and explosion-proof components. Beyond distribution, Lakeland provides equipment rentals for power monitoring and quality testing, engineering and consulting services, custom electrical enclosure fabrication through its Delta Fabricating division, and inventory management programs designed to prevent supply-chain disruptions.

Lakeland serves industrial and commercial customers that rely on electrical control systems, process automation, and hazardous-location equipment. Its client base includes organizations needing rapid access to replacement parts, custom enclosure solutions, and on-site technical support for critical infrastructure.

The company's stated differentiator is a refusal to force customers to choose among quality components, expert service, and fast delivery—a commitment articulated since its founding and reinforced through decades of expansion.

name: Lakeside Steel Manufacturing Co
old_description: Lakeside Steel & Mfg. Co. has served the metal fabrication needs for the power generation industry, material handling, construction equipment, and original equipment manufacturers for over 100 years. We use our experience, creativity, imagination, and best manufacturing principles to make the impossible possible for our customers.
about:
Lakeside Steel & Mfg. Co. operates from Kenosha, Wisconsin, where it has served the metal fabrication needs of the power generation industry, material handling, construction equipment, and original equipment manufacturers for over 100 years. The company’s history spans more than a century, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated.

The 41,000-square-foot facility houses a range of in-house processes including plasma and flame cutting, sawing, bending, rolling, punching, certified welding, and painting. A 600-ton hydraulic press brake, four plate rolls, twenty-two welding machines, and multiple overhead cranes support heavy fabrication; the shop has produced weldments as large as 13 feet 6 inches in diameter by 70 feet long weighing over 105,000 pounds. An adjacent 11,000-square-foot warehouse stocks carbon and stainless steel sheet, plate, and structural shapes, enabling rapid material availability. For specialized requirements, Lakeside coordinates stress relieving, blast cleaning, galvanizing, machining, and non-destructive testing through qualified subcontractors.

Customers span power generation, material handling, construction equipment, and OEM sectors. Project examples include combustors, air piping, coal ducts, trommels, inlet water pipes, forklift booms, shaker conveyors, fly ash silos, cement hoppers, explosion-door components, galvanized platforms, and a variety of structural frames and enclosures.

Lakeside emphasizes short lead times through multi-shift operations and an on-site steel inventory that eliminates delivery delays. Its location midway between Chicago and Milwaukee provides direct highway and rail access for nationwide shipping. The company cites its certified craftsmen, heavy-lifting capacity, and commitment to precise, timely fabrication as core differentiators.
